audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart read "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer and packet levelChart read Orianna 1-5 and Azir 6-7. Two answers to the same question.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row. Orianna's Command: Attack is 815 range against Azir's 525-range soldier placement, so she owns levels 1-5; from his first item the soldier DPS and Emperor's Divide flip it.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side -> Orianna, phases[5..6].side -> Azir, matching win[0..6] which already held those values; whys for rows 5 and 6 rewritten to describe Azir winning.

audit.why: Spike order is right: Lost Chapter, level 6 Shockwave, Luden's, then Azir overtaking on soldier DPS. Only the first-item row needed to say the spike belongs to him.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now names the soldier-DPS flip instead of an Orianna Luden's spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no cooldown number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and "Command Attack" was written for Command: Attack in three places.
audit.why: Shifting Sands (E) is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 and is both Azir's engage and his only escape; Conquering Sands (Q) is 14/12/10/8/6; Emperor's Divide is 120/105/90. Orianna's Q is 7/6/5/4/3, W a flat 7, E 9, R 110/95/80. Those numbers are what make "step up after he burns it" actionable.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rebuilt around the real E, Q and R timers; ability name corrected to Command: Attack.

audit.whatIsWrong: No sequencing cues anywhere (packet defect, sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: The punishable window is the 16-22s after Shifting Sands is spent.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns now key the Q-W trade to his spent E.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; unsupported magnitude "doubles every gank" in breakdown.mid.
audit.corrected: Both bullet bodies rewritten to match their titles; the magnitude replaced with what the ball actually delivers.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks a third of his bar. Shove, rotate, and let the ball-delivery threat run the river fights.
edits.after: First item turns his soldier DPS on — he out-ranges your 815 Q from behind them. Take pick angles, not soldier lanes.

edits.before: Late Ori is the teamfight: protect-ball on your diver, shockwave their clump, and dissonance the choke they retreat through.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide knocks your line off the ball before you cast — hold R until his 120-second wall is spent, then take the clump.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Check it before every step-up. - E Command: Protect is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Shifting Sands (E): 22s at rank 1, 16s maxed — his engage and his only escape. Step up the moment it is spent. - Conquering Sands (Q) is 14s at rank 1; once he shoves with it your Q-W contact is free. - Emperor's Divide is 120s. Shockwave is 110s — spend it on a body.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball sends your jungler in shielded with a live R.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Q is 7s at rank 1 and 3s maxed, W a flat 7s — cast the pair on every wave contact, then E the ball home before his Shifting Sands is back.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Shockwave is 110s at rank 1 — burning it on a wave means the next objective fight starts with your best button dark.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Azir wins by stacking soldiers behind a shoved wave, out-ranging your Q, and walling you off your own Shockwave.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — you pick the moment, and against Azir that means Shockwave after his 120-second wall is spent, never into a soldier screen.

edits.before: Track Azir’s Shifting Sands: His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Shifting Sands (E): 22s at rank 1, 16s maxed — his only escape and his only engage. Once it is burned, you can step up.

edits.before: Your Command Attack plus ball range out-trades Azir's stubby early soldiers.
edits.after: Your Command: Attack plus ball range out-trades Azir's stubby early soldiers.

edits.before: Your Command Attack into ball-Q trades outrange Azir's short-range soldiers before he stacks his passive; punch him whenever he steps up to last-hit and reset the ball back to yourself.
edits.after: Your Command: Attack into ball-Q trades outrange Azir's 525-range soldiers before he stacks passive; punch him when he steps up to last-hit and reset the ball back to yourself.

edits.before: You out-poke Azir at levels 1-3: your Command Attack range plus the ball carry beats his tiny early soldier reach, and every time he walks up to farm you can land a ball-forward Q and reset it onto yourself for the next trade.
edits.after: You out-poke Azir at levels 1-3: your Command: Attack range plus the ball carry beats his 525 soldier reach, and every time he walks up to farm you can land a ball-forward Q and reset it onto yourself for the next trade.

notes: Chart was cross-layer split: full layer had all seven rows as 'Skill', content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both had Orianna 1-5 / Azir 6-7. I moved the full layer onto the content values rather than the reverse, so no win[N] edits were needed (before would equal after); the pairing rule is satisfied by the rows now agreeing. packet.suspectNames flagged wants.foe[1] 'Land Emperor's Divide' — that is the correct Riot name and is a false positive; left alone. 'Command Attack' -> 'Command: Attack' was a real name error and is fixed in three places. Azir is male; no pronoun defects found.
